title: Optimize columnar vector top-k search
description: Avoid full sorting of all vector distances when ColumnarVectorStore::search only returns limit rows.
convergence_criteria: search uses select_nth_unstable_by; zero limit is handled; columnar tests pass
hints: Preserve ascending distance output for returned rows.
execution_directives: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --lib; cargo test --lib storage::columnar -- --nocapture; cargo test --lib storage::fusion -- --nocapture
findings: Replaced full distance sort with top-k partition plus final ordering of retained candidates; added tests for limited sorted results and zero-limit fast path.
